title: A push-scoped regression selector must cover the pushed range, not only HEAD^..HEAD
failure_mechanism: For a multi-commit push, selecting tests from HEAD^..HEAD ignores paths changed in earlier commits of the same push. The workflow can be green while a relevant regression family was never selected.

deduplication.why_not_duplicate: The nearest case verifies declared required steps after selection. This case verifies the integrity of the upstream change-range selector before a required-step manifest exists. An omitted scope is not necessarily represented as a skipped step.

verifier_gate.existing_branch_fast_forward_push: Compute relevant paths from the event before SHA through after SHA. HOLD when any required regression scope is absent from the selected set.
verifier_gate.new_branch_or_non_ancestor_range: UNKNOWN/HOLD until an explicit, tested range policy is supplied.
verifier_gate.forbidden_substitute: Do not infer full-push coverage from HEAD^..HEAD or from a green final job alone.

adoption_rule: Candidate only. Run against one Material workflow push fixture and preserve rollback. Do not make this global until Mother acknowledges relevance and a real workflow run demonstrates the range receipt.
acceptance: All relevant paths in an existing-branch fast-forward push are represented in selected regression scopes.
The receipt records exact before/after SHAs and the selected/required scope sets.
Unknown range forms fail closed rather than silently reducing scope.
